name: 06517 · Hamden, CT
findings: ZIP 06517 (Hamden) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06517 (Hamden) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
